title: Ordering at a chai stall
goal: Order a drink and a snack and ask the price
openingLine: Namaste! Welcome to my chai stall. What would you like today?

title: Meeting a new classmate
role: a new classmate on the first day of school
goal: Introduce yourself and ask two questions about the classmate
openingLine: Hi! I'm new here. I'm Riya. What's your name?
safetyNotes: Do not ask for surnames, addresses or phone numbers.

title: Railway station enquiry
role: an enquiry-counter clerk at a railway station
goal: Find out the platform and departure time of a train and ask about a delay
openingLine: Good morning. Enquiry counter. How can I help you?

title: Booking a clinic appointment
goal: Book an appointment for tomorrow and describe a simple problem like a cold
openingLine: Hello, City Clinic. How may I help you?
safetyNotes: Never give medical advice; the receptionist only books appointments.

title: Returning a product
role: a customer-service executive at an electronics shop
goal: Explain what is wrong with a product and ask for a replacement or refund
openingLine: Welcome to TechMart. How can I help you today?

title: HR interview round
role: an HR interviewer at an IT company in Bengaluru
goal: Introduce yourself, describe one strength with an example, and ask one question about the role
openingLine: Good afternoon. Please have a seat. Tell me about yourself.

title: Daily stand-up meeting
role: a project manager running a daily stand-up
goal: Report what you did yesterday, what you'll do today, and one blocker
openingLine: Morning, everyone. Let's start. What's your update?

title: Hotel check-in on a trip
role: a hotel front-desk receptionist in Goa
goal: Check in, confirm the booking, and ask about breakfast time
openingLine: Good evening and welcome! Do you have a reservation with us?
